combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Pantomime × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Chord sequence that brings a musical phrase to rest
Fireplace ash, and the pet name it earns the heroine
Man's voice pitched between the highest and the lowest of the male ranges
Units the conductor counts, marked off down the page by upright lines
Familiar name for the crisp potatoes done in the fat round the meat
Everything that comes with the meat when a dinner is done properly
Lyte begged the Lord to do this with him as eventide fell fast
Comic widow of the wash-house, mother to Aladdin
Handel oratorio whose Hallelujah chorus brings audiences to their feet
Meaty knuckle at the bottom of the leg, braised and brought to table whole
Overnight climber up to a giant's castle in the clouds
